unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager scope classification
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The repository snapshot sets knownManager=false and canonicalManager=null, while the supplied manager universe separately lists StepStone Group. Under the explicit contract, the knownManager flag governs this run and prevents inclusion or proposal of funds.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Reconcile the repository snapshot so the knownManager flag and supplied manager universe are consistent, then rerun the census.

notes: Scope gate applied: knownManager=false prohibits fund inclusion or proposal.
Official materials were reviewed only to confirm the scope issue was substantive rather than a naming mismatch.
